name: HIPPOMANES
common_names: The old famous Aphrodisiacum of the Greek authors.
key_symptoms: Violent pain in wrist. Paralysis of wrists. Sprained sensation in wrist. Great weakness of hands and fingers. Weakness in joints of feet, knee, and soles. Chorea. Much weakness after growing too fast.
guiding_symptoms: Violent pain in wrist. Paralysis of wrists. Sprained sensation in wrist. Great weakness of hands and fingers. Weakness in joints of feet, knee, and soles. Chorea. Much weakness after growing too fast.
urinary_symptoms: Sexual desire increased. Prostatitis. Drawing pain in testicles.
musculoskeletal_symptoms: Violent pain in wrist. Paralysis of wrists. Sprained sensation in wrist. Great weakness of hands and fingers. Weakness in joints of feet, knee, and soles. Chorea. Much weakness after growing too fast.
